big_idea: The brand book's opening line becomes the pre-launch story: ingredients with centuries of history, set to a modern standard and a ninety-day protocol. Three weeks move from mystique, to the formula, to the ritual, and every post points to the waitlist.

arc.purpose: Introduce The Lucid Institute and its world before showing a product. Mystique, the monumental type, the statue.
Reveal TESTIDE and open up TST-01: named, branded ingredients with exact amounts.
Turn the ninety-day ritual into the reason to sign up. Close on the waitlist.

items.headline: We've been waiting *thousands* of *years* for this
items.caption:
We've been waiting thousands of years for this.

The Lucid Institute is a new house of dietary supplements, built on ingredients with long histories and held to a modern standard.

Our first formula arrives soon. Join the waitlist at luciddaily.com.
items.claim_risk: None. Brand statement with no product benefit.

items.headline: A higher standard of *supplements*
items.caption:
A higher standard of supplements.

Every ingredient named. Every amount on the label. Branded, standardized extracts where they exist. Nothing hidden behind a blend we won't explain.

More soon.
items.claim_risk: None. Quality and transparency statements that the label supports (all amounts are listed).

items.caption:
For those building something that lasts.

The Lucid Institute. Dietary supplements, made in small runs, designed to be taken with intent.

The first formula is close.

Introducing TESTIDE.

Evolutionary testosterone support*, from The Lucid Institute. Ninety capsules in a paper tube. Powered by TST-01, our 1,450 mg blend of Tongkat Ali, PrimaVie® Shilajit, Furosap® Fenugreek, POMELLA® Pomegranate and Benfotiamine, with zinc, vitamin D, boron and choline.

For adult men only. Join the waitlist at luciddaily.com.

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
items.claim_risk: Structure/function tagline from the label, with asterisk; FDA line on the image and in the caption; 'for adult men only' included.

items.headline: Inside the formula
items.sub: Tongkat Ali|PrimaVie® Shilajit|Furosap® Fenugreek|POMELLA® Pomegranate|Bororganic Boron|Supporting cofactors
items.caption:
Inside TST-01.

Four named botanicals, each a branded or standardized extract, plus the cofactors that round out the formula. Swipe through each one, with the exact amount from the label.

Per three-capsule serving: Furosap® Fenugreek 500 mg, POMELLA® Pomegranate 400 mg, PrimaVie® Shilajit 250 mg, Tongkat Ali 200 mg (standardized to 2% eurycomanone), Benfotiamine 100 mg. Also zinc 3 mg, vitamin D 20 mcg, boron 200 mcg, choline 20 mg.
items.claim_risk: None. Ingredient names and label amounts only; no benefit stated.

items.headline: Tongkat Ali
items.sub: Eurycoma longifolia|Root extract · 200 mg|Standardized to 2% eurycomanone|From a tree native to Southeast Asia
items.claim_risk: None. Botanical name, amount, standardization and origin, as on the label.

items.headline: Shilajit
items.sub: PrimaVie®|Purified extract · 250 mg|A mineral-rich resin from Himalayan rock

items.headline: Fenugreek
items.sub: Trigonella foenum-graecum|Seed extract · 500 mg|Furosap®, the largest dose in TST-01
items.claim_risk: None. Name and amount; 'largest dose' is a literal comparison of label amounts.

items.headline: Supporting cofactors
items.sub: Benfotiamine, 100 mg|Zinc bisglycinate, 3 mg|Vitamin D3, 20 mcg|Boron glycinate, 200 mcg|Choline, 20 mg
items.claim_risk: None. Amounts match the Supplement Facts panel.

items.headline: A formula worthy of *the gods*
items.caption:
A formula worthy of the gods. Built for the mortals.

TESTIDE is made for the man who shows up every morning: three capsules, with food, every day.

Join the waitlist at luciddaily.com.
items.claim_risk: Puffery only (brand book line); no benefit or result stated.

items.sub: Three capsules each morning|With food, every day|For ninety days
items.caption:
The Protocol.

I. Three capsules each morning.
II. With food, every day.
III. For ninety days.

One tube holds thirty mornings. The full protocol is three tubes. Save this for day one.
items.claim_risk: None. Directions exactly as on the label; no outcome promised for the ninety days.

rationale: Mystique first, because the brand world is the asset competitors cannot copy; then a transparent formula, because the label lists every amount; then the ritual, because a ninety-day protocol is the reason to buy three tubes. Claims stay at the label's own structure/function line, with the FDA statement wherever it appears.
